data.one_liner: iOS implementation of the url_launcher plugin for launching URLs on iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides the platform‑specific code that enables the url_launcher API to open web links, mailto links, and other URLs on iOS. Handles Safari view controller behavior and mode support.
use_when: You need to launch URLs on iOS as part of a Flutter app
You rely on the url_launcher API and want automatic iOS support
avoid_when: You are targeting only non‑iOS platforms
You need a custom URL‑handling implementation beyond what url_launcher offers
weaknesses: Only works on iOS, no functionality on other platforms
Must be added to pubspec only if imported directly

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform wrapper that includes iOS, Android, web, and desktop implementations

alternatives.name: url_launcher_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the Android counterpart if you need platform‑specific control
